versions.changelog: Clean patch: remove private environment wording, add durable Paperless success/evidence structure, and use portable trusted-helper terminology.
Metadata-only correction: align install description with the actual Paperless cloud intake hardening scope so security review is not misled.
Hardens Paperless cloud intake guidance under constrained macOS/OpenClaw node-helper boundaries; deprecates automated Quick Look; adds Linux/Windows caveats and provenance notes.

V2 adds provider-aware cloud materialization guidance, iCloud native hydration, OneDrive Quick Look as explicit gated fallback, Paperless consumer verification, causal testing, and generic nudge cross-reference.

Initial release: Introduces robust procedures for safely ingesting files from cloud-synced folders into Paperless-ngx.

- Prevents Paperless from ingesting incomplete or placeholder files by staging and verifying files before handoff.
- Advises on privacy: shares guidance on anonymizing workflow details and example paths.
- Details when to apply (or not apply) this procedure based on deployment and file source scenarios.
- Outlines safe trigger strategies, including both event-based and periodic scans, with tailored advice for macOS and privacy settings.
- Includes deployment discovery steps, supporting various Paperless installation methods (Docker, Synology, bare-metal).
- Specifies recommended design: lightweight triggers, strong staging/verification, atomic moves, retries, and Paperless-side verification.
